name: backgrounds
prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Create a production raster asset sheet for an interactive grade 9-10 anatomy textbook. The supplied reference is the user's invented FAROUT FUN aesthetic: richly tactile torn tissue-paper collage, layered hand-cut colored paper, deckled edges, cobalt blue, coral, violet, golden yellow, cream paper, exuberant but precise forms. Apply its drawing manner, not its existing poster composition. Create FOUR separate portrait page backgrounds arranged in an exact 2 by 2 grid, each same size, no gutters. Each page has deep cobalt textured collage border and a large quiet pale cream paper working area occupying bottom two thirds, for movable illustrations added later. The upper third contains a small but carefully drawn contextual locator and two or three concise labels; no loose item icons in the working area. Top left page: cell membrane bilayer close-up enlarged above a little body-to-cell scale locator; labels 'INSIDE / OUTSIDE' and 'Membrane boundary'. Top right page: shoulder-to-hand regional locator only, tiny upper-left, large entire rest of cream page EMPTY to receive one arm model; heading 'BONES + MUSCLES'. Bottom left page: accurate ear cutaway across top quarter, coral outer ear, gold ossicles, purple cochlea, yellow hearing nerve; a linked magnifying circle shows attached hair cells between supporting membranes; heading 'VIBRATION TO SIGNAL'. Bottom right page: connected digestive tract locator in upper quarter with mouth, stomach, liver/gallbladder/pancreas, small intestine, three thin leaders to small headings 'Mouth: saliva', 'Stomach: protein', 'Intestine: bile + enzymes'; entire bottom two thirds quiet cream. Modern explanatory organization and harmonious relative scales. No extra slogans, no UI controls. Large high quality sheet 2048x3072.
